agyos_skill.instructions: The **time-axis** reuse discipline — turn a *proven evergreen* asset into multiple cycles, **refreshed each time** so it's a new asset, not a stale duplicate. The agent drafts the refresh; a human reviews; **scheduling-and-queue → WoopSocial** publishes. Most accounts treat content as disposable — publish once, never again — and waste their best assets. But **~80%+ of your audience misses any given post** (only ~5–10% of a network sees it), and new followers never saw it at all. So your proven evergreen winners are **compounding assets.** Recycle them — but **refresh, don't duplicate** (identical reposting risks Meta's 2026 originality penalties and fatigues the core audience). Recycle **winners from a ranked list, not from memory.** 1. **brand-profile** — pillars, non-negotiables (so the refresh stays on-brand). 2. **voice-builder** — so the refreshed version sounds like the brand. (Depth: `references/the-reuse-framework.md`.) - **R — Resurface the winners:** audit **native analytics** for proven *evergreen* pieces (by goal: engagement → saves/shares; traffic → CTR; growth → follows) + strong-but-underseen posts. Keep a recycling vault. - **E — Earn the slot again:** recycle the insight with a **new hook/angle/format**; change **one major variable** per variant; **never repeat the same opening line.** Editing, not duplication. - **U — Update for now:** verify facts/stats/dates/prices/links are current; refresh anything stale; re-check compliance; **disclose** AI-refreshed media. - **S — Schedule the cycle:** space each asset **~90–120 days**; don't dump a backlog; adapt to the destination platform's native format. - **E — Evaluate & re-queue:** read native analytics per cycle; run one-variable tests; promote winners back into the queue, retire the rest. **Recycle:** evergreen + proven — tips, frameworks, timeless case studies, product guides, core messaging; and strong-but-underseen pieces. **Don't:** events, seasonal promos, dated news, trend-jacks. **Constraint:** Meta's 2026 Original Content rules throttle/demonetize duplicate reposts
